Robert Pattinson Cast as New James Bond

Robert Pattinson has been named as the newest actor to portray James Bond. This casting has drawn commentary from various figures, including Amazon boss Jeff Bezos, who stated it was "so obvious" to pick Pattinson. Actor Rami Malek, who played a Bond villain, has also given his judgment on the casting. One outlet noted the connection between Pattinson's role in "Twilight" and his casting as James Bond, questioning if the former predicted the latter. Additionally, a Google search for "Robert Pattinson" reportedly triggered a "James Bond surprise."
